messages.subject: Halstead v Ferncliffe — strategy and next steps (internal)
messages.plaintextBody:
Sarah, Tom,

Internal note on Halstead v Ferncliffe.

Liability: strong. Frost's report nails causation (beta-flecks pre-date delivery; alpha-case on un-machined sections). Their best point is the clause 12 acceptance/notification argument, answered by latency + the time full metallography takes.

Quantum: ~£2.9m direct. Vulnerable heads are the £412k Caldera LD exposure (remoteness) and the 14-day line-stop. I'd plead both but treat the LDs as a give.

Proposal: instruct Catherine Rosenthal KC for an advice on merits/quantum before we issue; she can also settle the Particulars. Tom to start the chronology and the disclosure index.

James

James Osei
Senior Associate | Whitfield Carter LLP
T +44 (0)20 7946 0034
